description: This file defines a Java class 'MessageOnlyLogFilter' that implements the 'LogNode' interface. The class acts as a filter in a logging chain, passing only the message content downstream while filtering out other metadata such as priority, tag, and exceptions.

classes.description: A log filter class that forwards only log messages, ignoring all other metadata.
